blocks.text: TCP segments carry ports, IP packets carry network addresses.

blocks.title: Frame on local link
blocks.text: Ethernet/Wi-Fi frame delivers packet over one link, then changes at next hop.

blocks.title: Worked example · Ethernet frame
blocks.text: HTTP application bytes become TCP segment payload; the TCP segment goes into an IP packet; the packet is carried in an Ethernet frame. Receivers process headers in reverse to deliver data to the browser/server.

blocks.title: Outgoing Wi-Fi frame
blocks.text: Router removes the incoming link-layer framing, processes/forwards the IP packet and builds new outgoing link-layer framing. IP hop limit/TTL normally decreases; end-to-end transport data need not change.
